summary: Verified STEP 1 Basic Info wizard redesign and functional draft-save for independent providers. Backend: 7/7 pytest pass (register → POST /api/providers/profile, duplicate rejected, PUT updates persist breast_size/breast_type/ethnicity/tattoos/contact.telegramId, GET /api/providers/{id} returns persisted characteristics, Browse /api/providers?breast_type=Enhanced OK). Frontend: fresh independent provider lands on /dashboard with 'Step 1 of 5 · About 6 minutes left' label, numbered horizontal stepper (Basic Info active), and the three white cards (basic-info-card, contact-info-card, physical-characteristics-card). Filling all fields and clicking 'Save & continue' (data-testid=next-button) issues EXACTLY ONE POST to /api/providers/profile and advances to Step 2. Returning to Step 1 and editing essence triggers a debounced PUT after ~2s and the draft-status pill shows 'Draft saved' (no silent extra POST — duplicate-create guard works). 'Save & exit' saves the draft and navigates to /dashboard. Telegram pill toggles the required telegram-id-input (contact-telegram → telegram-id-input visible, saved to contact.telegramId). New characteristics fields breast_size (A/B/C/D/DD+) and breast_type (Natural/Enhanced) are selectable via data-testid=char-breast_size-c / char-breast_type-enhanced and persist to the backend. Browse ExtraFilters shows Natural/Enhanced (not 'Implants') and /api/providers responds 200 with filter applied.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warnings: <span data-ve-dynamic="true"> wrappers injected between <select> and <option> for the country/nationality dropdowns. Non-functional (dropdowns still work and save) but produces console errors. Same instrumentation issue previously flagged for admin tables in iteration_16.

action_items: No functional fixes required — all user-choice features (functional Draft saved indicator, functional Save & exit, breast_size/breast_type persisted, new header/stepper/footer on Step 1) are working end-to-end.

(Low priority, pre-existing) The ve-dynamic <span> instrumentation wraps <option>/<tr> children and produces React hydration errors. Not a regression from this change but worth flagging to the platform.
critical_code_review_comments: saveDraft() correctly guards against silent creation: autosave useEffect only PUTs when a profile already exists (dashboard.profile OR createdProviderId), while the explicit Save & continue passes allowCreate:true. Verified via network inspection — one POST, subsequent edits PUT.
canPersistDraft requires display_name + country (for non-agency) — matches handleCreateProfile preconditions, so Save & exit won't attempt to persist a half-empty draft.

BasicInfoStep.jsx cleanly extracted; data-testid coverage is thorough (display-name-input, age-input, gender-input-*, orientation-input-*, city-input, country-input, essence-input, basic-lang-*, contact-*, telegram-id-input, char-*). Good testability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 7 test scenarios in review request pass)

test_credentials: Dynamic registration via POST /api/auth/register with role=provider, account_type=independent, password=test1234 — works as expected and lands user directly on the wizard at /dashboard.
seed_data_creation: Each run creates one TEST_wiz_* provider via /api/auth/register and one TEST_Mila profile. Residual test data remains in DB (not cleaned); consistent with repo convention of TEST_ prefix for easy cleanup later.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite /app/backend/tests/test_basic_info_wizard.py requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env (set from /app/frontend/.env). Independent providers created via /api/auth/register land directly on /dashboard which renders the ProviderDashboard wizard (no profile => Step 1). The GET helper /api/providers (list) hides unverified providers, so to verify a freshly-saved profile use /api/providers/{provider_id} with the cookie session — the backend tests already cover this. Email verification banner shows on the wizard but does NOT block draft-save / step navigation (only publish/activate).
